Email link is the portal for website and iPhone. It does not approve an operator, take payment, or share a tour with a client.

Sent to . Open the link in that email, or paste the six-digit code from it here. The code and the link both expire, and each works once.

  1. Save a space. Suburb or city only — no street address.
  2. Capture and reconstruct in Veylet Capture on the iPhone, signed in with this same email.
  3. Send the tour package from the app to this space.
  4. Preview it here, then Create client handoff. Only the person holding the unlisted link can open it, and you can revoke it at any time.

Your spaces

    Tours stay on this account until you create a handoff. A handoff is unlisted: it is not a public gallery, it is not indexed, and Revoke stops it working.
